item.title: [AI Prompt Workflow] AI Layout Deconstruct & Rebuild Brief
item.description: The drive for AI to accurately interpret and rebuild existing web layouts is critical for rapid prototyping and iteration. This system leverages precise input extraction (layout, colors, fonts, interactions) to generate rebuild briefs, minimizing AI's "guessing" phase and boosting design efficiency. | Fonts: Montserrat Bold + IBM Plex Mono | Palette: #2C3E50 #ECF0F1 #3498DB #E74C3C | Prompt: Act as a UI/UX expert. Analyze the provided webpage URL. Extract its core layout structure (grid, flex), primary and secondary color palette, font families for headlines/body, key interactive elements (buttons, forms), and user flow patterns. Generate a detailed, structured JSON brief for an LLM to rebuild this page, ensuring all these elements are specified with precision. Focus on interaction states and responsive breakpoints.

item.title: [UI & Layout] Perceptually-Smooth Gradient Fix
item.description: The signal highlights a common visual flaw in digital gradients, where direct color interpolation creates desaturated 'muddy' midpoints. Adopting perceptually uniform color spaces (like Oklab) ensures gradients maintain vibrancy and smooth transitions, improving overall aesthetic quality and perceived professionalism in UI. | Fonts: Neue Haas Grotesk Display + Inter | Palette: #007BFF #FFD700 #FF6347 #20B2AA | Prompt: When designing UI elements requiring smooth color transitions, specify `color-interpolation: linearRGB` for standard CSS, but strongly recommend implementing gradients within a perceptually uniform color space like Oklab via design tools or post-processing. This ensures vibrant, non-muddy transitions, enhancing visual sophistication and user experience. Prioritize gradient consistency across light/dark modes.

item.title: [UI & Layout] Vibrant Gradient Fix: Perceptual Blends
item.description: Traditional RGB blending interpolates colors linearly, often creating muddy mid-points due to human perception of lightness. Adopting perceptual color spaces like LCH ensures smooth, visually harmonious transitions, significantly enhancing visual appeal in UI elements. | Fonts: Inter Display + Fira Sans | Palette: #1A2CFF #FFD700 #FF4500 #00FF7F | Prompt: Design a UI card with a vibrant background gradient from #FFD700 to #1A2CFF. Ensure the gradient uses LCH color interpolation for a perceptually smooth transition, avoiding any muddy mid-tones. Include a subtle radial texture overlay at 15% opacity. Display a clear call-to-action button centered.
